requirementTraceRows.title: Dashboard Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall consume dashboard summary data from Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall consume canonical entity records from Airframe Core for projects, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, verification gates, evidence, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall consume metric records computed by Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Local Presentation State
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit may maintain local presentation state such as user-selected filters, collapsed sections, and dashboard preferences. Such state shall not override authoritative Airframe Core workflow state.

---

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Dashboard
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display a consolidated dashboard for one or more configured projects.

requirementTraceRows.title: Recently Completed Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display recently completed work items, including completed issues, tasks, merged pull requests, or backend-equivalent work records where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Active Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display currently active work items grouped by project, sprint, epic, status, or priority.

requirementTraceRows.title: Upcoming Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display upcoming work items based on Airframe Core-provided priority, sprint, epic, backlog, or readiness information.

requirementTraceRows.title: Blocked Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display blocked work items and associated blocked reasons where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Ready for Human Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display work items that have been marked ready for human verification by an authorized actor.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Review
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to review verification evidence associated with a work item.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accept Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to accept completed work only after Airframe Core determines the operation is allowed by actor authority and workflow state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reject Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to reject work and return it to an appropriate workflow state with a required reason or comment.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sprint Control
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close sprints, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Epic Control
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close epics, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Issue / Task Review
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display issues and tasks using canonical Airframe Core entity data independent of backend-specific storage.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Display
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall display Airframe Core-provided metrics including, at minimum:

- Sprint progress.
- Burndown.
- Velocity.
- Blocked work count.
- Recently completed work count.
- Work ready for verification.
- Aging of verification items.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Visibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall provide access to audit events associated with project-management actions, including allowed and denied operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Multi-Project View
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support viewing multiple projects in a consolidated dashboard.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project-Specific View
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support drilling into a single project for detailed review.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend-Agnostic Operation Display
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall present operations and entities using Airframe Core domain terms rather than backend-specific terminology where practical.

requirementTraceRows.title: Denied Operation Reporting
requirementTraceRows.statement:
When Airframe Core denies an operation, Agile Cockpit shall display the denial reason in human-readable form.

---

## 4. Security and Authority Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Airframe Core API
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall use Airframe Core APIs for all project-management reads and writes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Configuration Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall load project and workspace configuration through Airframe Core-defined configuration interfaces.

requirementTraceRows.title: Export Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit should support exporting dashboard summaries or reports in Markdown, HTML, JSON, or other formats defined by project needs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accessibility Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall provide accessible navigation, readable status indicators, keyboard access where applicable, and concise views suitable for low-click interaction.

---

## 7. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Usability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall prioritize one- or two-click access to current status, recently completed work, active work, upcoming work, blocked work, and verification queues.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accessibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall be designed with accessibility as a primary concern.

requirementTraceRows.title: Performance
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall load dashboard summaries for configured projects without requiring full backend ingestion during routine use, where cached or summarized data is available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reliability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall clearly report stale data, backend failures, authorization failures, and synchronization errors.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Independence
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall not hard-code assumptions specific to GitHub or any other backend provider.

requirementTraceRows.title: Maintainability
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall keep UI logic separate from Airframe Core workflow and authority logic.

---

## 8. Verification Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Certified Actor Identity
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall rely on Airframe Core to certify actor identity and actor type before any write operation is requested.

requirementTraceRows.title: No Self-Declared Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall not allow a user or client process to self-declare an actor type for the purpose of obtaining authority.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Operations
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall expose human-only operations only to authenticated and authorized human actor types as determined by Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Context Binding
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall include project context in all operation requests. Airframe Core shall determine whether the actor may operate on the target project.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sensitive Operation Confirmation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall require explicit human confirmation before requesting sensitive operations such as closing a sprint, closing an epic, bulk status changes, or configuration changes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Event Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit write operations shall result in Airframe Core-generated audit events.

---

## 5. Data Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Dashboard Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that Agile Cockpit displays project summaries, active work, upcoming work, blocked work, and recently completed work from Airframe Core-provided data.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that human-only operations are not presented or are disabled for unauthorized actor types.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that Agile Cockpit properly handles allowed and denied Airframe Core workflow operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify correct display of Airframe Core-provided burndown, velocity, and sprint progress metrics.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accessibility Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall undergo accessibility checks appropriate to the selected UI platform.

---

## 9. Open Issues

- UI platform selected: native macOS 26 SwiftUI application; see `docs/architecture/CSCI_Project_Form_Trade_Study.md`.
- The initial authentication mechanism for local human use remains to be selected.
- The first backend adapter is expected to be GitHub, but Agile Cockpit shall remain backend-agnostic.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Independence
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall preserve backend independence by using canonical entities and operations above the adapter layer.

requirementTraceRows.title: Initial Backend
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support at least one initial backend adapter suitable for development and verification.

requirementTraceRows.title: GitHub Backend
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core should support a GitHub backend adapter mapping canonical entities to GitHub Issues, Projects, Milestones, Pull Requests, Actions, labels, comments, and related data where practical.

requirementTraceRows.title: Local Backend
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core should support a local Markdown or SQLite backend for testing, offline workflows, or development without external service dependency.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Failure Handling
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall report backend failures with clear error classifications and shall avoid partial silent updates.

---

## 8. Metrics Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Identifiers
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define stable canonical identifiers and backend reference mappings for all managed entities.

requirementTraceRows.title: Required Entity Fields
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define required fields for projects, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, verification gates, evidence, actors, policies, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow State Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall maintain or reconstruct workflow state records for managed entities.

requirementTraceRows.title: Evidence Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support evidence records associated with verification gates or work items.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall expose computed metrics in canonical format independent of backend provider.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Mapping Records
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall maintain mappings between canonical entity identifiers and backend-specific identifiers.

---

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Canonical Project Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define canonical representations for projects, repositories, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, verification gates, evidence, actors, credentials, authority classes, workflow states, metrics, backend references, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Actor Identity Certification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall certify actor identity from trusted credential context, session information, or configured identity providers.

requirementTraceRows.title: Actor Type Certification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall derive actor type or authority class from certified identity and policy. Airframe Core shall not accept actor type as a trusted caller-provided assertion.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Context Binding
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall bind each operation to an execution project and target project and shall enforce project-scope rules.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Scope Mismatch Denial
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall deny mutation operations when execution project and target project do not match and no explicit cross-project delegation exists.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define and enforce operation permissions by actor type, project context, target entity, credential scope, and workflow state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow State Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define workflow states for project entities and shall validate all requested state transitions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Gates
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall enforce human-only gates for accepting work, closing work, opening or closing sprints, opening or closing epics, approving architecture decisions, and changing workflow policies.

requirementTraceRows.title: LLM-Allowed Operations
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support LLM-allowed operations including proposing issues, proposing tasks, attaching evidence, and marking work ready for human verification.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Creation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support creation of canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Update
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support updates to canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Query
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support queries for projects, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, evidence, verification gates, metrics, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sprint Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model sprints, including status, date range, contained work, progress, completion state, and closure criteria.

requirementTraceRows.title: Epic Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model epics, including contained work, progress, status, and closure criteria.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model verification gates, evidence records, acceptance criteria, and human verification outcomes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Task Packet Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall generate compact task packets for AI Cockpit containing only relevant task context, constraints, acceptance criteria, verification commands, protected paths, and required reporting information.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Computation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall compute project metrics including sprint progress, burndown, velocity, blocked work, recently completed work, upcoming work, active work, and verification aging.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Event Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall generate audit events for allowed and denied write operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Adapter Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define backend adapter interfaces for reading and writing canonical entities to external backends.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Capability Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support a capability model describing what each backend adapter can and cannot represent natively.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Mapping
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall map canonical entities and operations to backend-specific representations through adapters.

requirementTraceRows.title: Local Cache
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core may maintain a local cache for performance, metrics, offline inspection, or dashboard generation. The cache shall not silently override authoritative backend state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Configuration Model
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall define configuration for projects, backend adapters, actor policies, workflow rules, protected paths, verification commands, and cross-project delegations.

---

## 4. Security Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Public API
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall expose a public API for client CSCIs to perform domain operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Read APIs
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall provide read APIs for dashboard summaries, project status, entity queries, metrics, task packets, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Write APIs
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall provide write APIs for entity creation, entity update, workflow transitions, evidence attachment, sprint operations, epic operations, and verification operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority APIs
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall expose APIs for evaluating whether an operation is allowed, denied, or requires additional confirmation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Adapter API
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define a backend adapter interface to be implemented by provider-specific adapters.

requirementTraceRows.title: Configuration API
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define loading, validation, and querying of project and workflow configuration.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit API
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall expose audit event recording and query interfaces.

---

## 7. Backend Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Sprint Progress
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall compute sprint progress based on sprint contents and work item status.

requirementTraceRows.title: Burndown
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall compute burndown data where estimates and sprint date ranges are available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Velocity
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall compute velocity across completed sprints where historical estimates are available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Blocked Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall identify blocked work and blocked reasons.

requirementTraceRows.title: Recently Completed Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall identify recently completed work based on workflow transition history or backend state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Upcoming Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall identify upcoming work from priority, sprint, epic, and readiness data.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Aging
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall compute age of items waiting for human verification.

---

## 9. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Portability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall be designed as a reusable package or library usable by both UI and CLI clients.

requirementTraceRows.title: Maintainability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall separate domain model, workflow policy, authority evaluation, backend adapters, metrics, audit, and configuration concerns.

requirementTraceRows.title: Testability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support unit tests, mock backend tests, policy tests, workflow transition tests, and metrics tests.

requirementTraceRows.title: Performance
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support efficient dashboard and task-packet generation without requiring unnecessary full-project context loading.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reliability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall handle backend errors, stale data, invalid transitions, authorization failures, and configuration errors predictably.

requirementTraceRows.title: Extensibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support adding backend adapters, entity types, metrics, and policy rules without requiring changes to client CSCIs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Token Efficiency
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall support generation of compact summaries and task packets to reduce LLM token usage.

---

## 10. Verification Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Deny by Default
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall deny operations when actor identity, actor type, project context, target project, operation permission, or workflow state cannot be certified.

requirementTraceRows.title: Credential Scope Validation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall validate credential scope before permitting write operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: No Self-Declared Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall not trust caller-provided authority class, actor type, or project scope unless derived from trusted credential context or configuration.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project-Scoped Mutation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall only allow mutation of entities belonging to the actor's certified execution project unless explicit cross-project delegation exists.

requirementTraceRows.title: Cross-Project Delegation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support explicit, narrow, auditable cross-project delegation policies.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Operation Enforcement
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall prevent non-human actors from performing human-only operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sensitive Operation Policy
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support policy requirements for confirmation or additional checks before sensitive operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Trail Integrity
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall generate audit events that identify actor, actor type, execution project, target project, operation, result, reason code, target entity, backend reference, and timestamp where available.

---

## 5. Data Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Domain Model Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify canonical entity creation, validation, serialization, and mapping.

requirementTraceRows.title: Identity Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify identity certification and actor type derivation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify permission evaluation for all defined actor types.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Scope Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that project context binding prevents unauthorized cross-project mutation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify allowed and denied state transitions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Adapter Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify adapter mappings using mock or local backends.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify burndown, velocity, sprint progress, blocked work, recently completed work, and verification aging calculations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Tests shall verify audit event creation for allowed and denied write operations.

---

## 11. Open Issues

- Implementation language and packaging strategy remain to be selected.
- Initial backend adapter selection remains open between GitHub-first and local-backend-first.
- Final canonical workflow states remain to be finalized.
- Credential and identity-provider mechanisms remain to be selected.

requirementTraceRows.title: Task Packet Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall consume task packet data generated or assembled by Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Proposal Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall provide proposal data for issues and tasks using Airframe Core canonical fields.

requirementTraceRows.title: Evidence Data
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall support evidence records containing summary, source, timestamp, command results, file references, and optional backend references.

requirementTraceRows.title: Output Data Minimization
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AI Cockpit shall minimize output to the data required for the requested operation unless verbose output is explicitly requested.

---

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Command-Line Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall provide a command-line interface for project-management operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Context Discovery
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall determine the execution project from Airframe Core-certified context, configuration, or credential scope.

requirementTraceRows.title: Propose Issue
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall allow authorized LLM agents to propose issues within their certified project context.

requirementTraceRows.title: Propose Task
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall allow authorized LLM agents to propose tasks within their certified project context.

requirementTraceRows.title: Retrieve Next Task
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall support retrieval of the next task appropriate to the agent's execution project and authority.

requirementTraceRows.title: Generate Task Packet
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AI Cockpit shall generate compact task packets containing:

- Project name.
- Work item identifier.
- Objective.
- Scope.
- Out-of-scope constraints.
- Acceptance criteria.
- Verification requirements.
- Relevant files, when available.
- Protected paths or no-touch areas.
- Required final report format.

requirementTraceRows.title: Attach Evidence
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall allow authorized agents to attach evidence to a work item, including command output summaries, test results, changed files, or implementation notes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Mark Ready for Human Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall allow authorized agents to request transition of a work item to Ready for Human Verification when Airframe Core permits the transition.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Summary
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall support compact project summary output for the execution project.

requirementTraceRows.title: Multi-Project Summary Restrictions
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall not allow an LLM agent to retrieve or mutate multi-project data unless the actor has explicit authority or read-only aggregation permission.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deny Human-Only Operations
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall deny attempts by LLM agents to accept work, reject work as final, close issues, open or close sprints, open or close epics, approve architecture decisions, or change workflow rules.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Scope Mismatch Detection
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall detect and report project scope mismatches returned by Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Structured Output
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall support structured output formats suitable for LLM consumption, including Markdown and JSON.

requirementTraceRows.title: Dry-Run Mode
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit should support a dry-run mode that validates an operation without committing backend changes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Display
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AI Cockpit shall display or return audit identifiers for write operations where available.

---

## 4. Security and Authority Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Airframe Core API
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall use Airframe Core APIs for all project-management operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: CLI Command Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit commands shall use domain terms such as issue, task, evidence, verification, sprint, and epic rather than backend-specific names.

requirementTraceRows.title: Machine-Readable Output
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall provide machine-readable output suitable for LLM or automation consumption.

requirementTraceRows.title: Error Output
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall provide concise, structured error output including reason codes for denied operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Configuration Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AI Cockpit shall load project and actor context using Airframe Core-defined configuration mechanisms.

---

## 7. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Token Efficiency
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall be optimized to reduce LLM token consumption by returning compact, relevant, task-specific information.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deterministic Output
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit output shall be deterministic for a given request and system state, excluding timestamps or backend-generated identifiers.

requirementTraceRows.title: Portability
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall operate in local development environments used by coding agents and automation workflows.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reliability
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall clearly distinguish backend failures, authentication failures, authorization failures, invalid workflow transitions, and project scope mismatches.

requirementTraceRows.title: Maintainability
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AI Cockpit shall keep command parsing and output formatting separate from Airframe Core authority and workflow logic.

---

## 8. Verification Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Certified Agent Identity
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall rely on Airframe Core to authenticate and certify the actor identity and actor type.

requirementTraceRows.title: No Actor Spoofing
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall not accept command-line flags or input fields that grant or override actor type, role, or authority.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project-Scoped Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall enforce Airframe Core's project-scoped authority decisions. An agent running under project X shall not mutate project Z unless explicit cross-project delegation exists.

requirementTraceRows.title: Credential Scope Validation
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall provide credential context to Airframe Core when required to validate operation scope.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deny by Default
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall deny operations when identity, actor type, project context, target project, or workflow state cannot be certified.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Gate Protection
requirementTraceRows.statement: AI Cockpit shall not provide bypass mechanisms for human-only workflow gates.

requirementTraceRows.title: Auditability
requirementTraceRows.statement:
All AI Cockpit write operations shall result in Airframe Core-generated audit events.

---

## 5. Data Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Command Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify AI Cockpit command parsing and output formatting.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Denial Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that LLM agents cannot perform human-only operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Scope Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that an agent operating under one project context cannot mutate another project without explicit delegation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Task Packet Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that task packets contain required sections and omit unrelated context.

requirementTraceRows.title: Evidence Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement: Tests shall verify that evidence can be attached only to authorized target work items.

requirementTraceRows.title: Output Format Tests
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Tests shall verify Markdown and JSON output formats.

---

## 9. Open Issues

- Final CLI command names remain to be selected.
- Initial credential strategy for local LLM agents remains to be selected.
- Initial backend adapter is expected to be GitHub, but AI Cockpit shall remain backend-agnostic through Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Canonical Repo-Local Store
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall maintain canonical workflow state in a repo-local structured store.

Rationale: workflow state must move with the source code across branches, forks, checkouts, and reverts.

requirementTraceRows.title: Stable Work Item Identity
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall assign stable IDs to Epics, Sprints, Tasks, Issues, Requirements, Evidence records, and Trace records.

requirementTraceRows.title: Relationship Model
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall represent relationships between work products by ID, including:

- Epic to Sprint.
- Epic to Task.
- Epic to Issue.
- Sprint to Task.
- Sprint to Issue.
- Requirement to Task.
- Requirement to Test.
- Requirement to Evidence.
- Task or Issue to Evidence.
- Work item to GitHub issue where applicable.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow Policy Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall own workflow status definitions, allowed transitions, preconditions, and authority checks.

requirementTraceRows.title: Markdown Projection
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating human-readable Markdown documentation from canonical records.

Markdown projections shall not be the sole source of workflow truth.

requirementTraceRows.title: Validation Diagnostics
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AirframeCore shall detect inconsistent workflow state and report diagnostics with:

- Severity.
- Affected IDs.
- Reason code.
- Explanation.
- Recommended repair options.
- Required authority for repair.

requirementTraceRows.title: Repair Preview
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support previewing proposed repair actions before applying them.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Events
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall record audit events for canonical state mutations, including actor, operation, affected IDs, before state, after state, and authority decision.

requirementTraceRows.title: Test Evidence Summary
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support recording summarized test evidence without storing every raw local test run.

At minimum, test evidence shall include:

- Command or test source.
- Pass/fail summary.
- Relevant failing tests when applicable.
- Timestamp.
- Environment summary.
- Linked requirement IDs when applicable.
- Optional CI run or artifact link.

requirementTraceRows.title: CI Evidence Link
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support linking verification evidence to CI runs or CI artifacts when CI is configured.

CI evidence shall supplement, not replace, AirframeCore requirement verification policy.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Traceability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support traceability between requirements, implementation work, tests, evidence, and release decisions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Fluid Requirements
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support requirement changes during development, including created, revised, superseded, deferred, waived, and removed requirement states.

requirementTraceRows.title: External Import Export Stubs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall reserve interfaces for importing and exporting requirements from external tools.

Version 1.0 shall prioritize diffable local formats such as CSV and JSON. DOORS integration shall remain out of scope for Version 1.0 but shall not be precluded by the data model.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Candidate Gate
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support release candidate close criteria based on workflow state, requirement traceability, verification evidence, validation approval, deviations, and blocking Issues.

requirementTraceRows.title: Generated Compliance Outputs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating compliance and traceability documents from canonical records when templates are available.

Candidate outputs include:

- Compliance Verification Matrix.
- Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Bidirectional Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Deviation or waiver report.
- Test plan.
- Verification report.
- Release candidate closeout package.

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Diffability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Canonical local state should be reasonably diffable in Git.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human Inspectability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Canonical state should be inspectable by humans using common repository tools.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deterministic Projection
requirementTraceRows.statement: Generated documentation should be deterministic to avoid noisy diffs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backward Compatibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Existing Markdown artifacts shall remain importable during migration.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Preservation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Human-only verification, Sprint closure, Epic closure, release closeout, destructive repair, and policy mutation shall remain protected by AirframeCore authority evaluation.

## 5. Version 1.0 Boundary

Version 1.0 should include:

- Canonical repo-local state model.
- Basic requirement records.
- Requirement-to-work and requirement-to-test trace links.
- Summary test evidence.
- CI evidence link fields.
- CSV and JSON requirement import/export.
- Generated Markdown projections.
- Data health diagnostics.
- Initial AgileCockpit release gate visibility.

Version 1.0 should not include:

- Native DOORS integration.
- Full enterprise requirements management.
- Full document-template authoring.
- Server-based synchronization.
- Mandated code comments for every requirement.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall maintain canonical requirement records with stable IDs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Revision State
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support requirement revision metadata, including status, source, version, rationale, and change history.

requirementTraceRows.title: Fluid Requirement Lifecycle
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support requirement lifecycle states suitable for active development, including:

- Proposed.
- Draft.
- Active.
- Implemented.
- Verified.
- Validated.
- Deferred.
- Waived.
- Superseded.
- Removed.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Source
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall record whether a requirement was authored in Airframe, imported from a file, imported from an external tool, generated from another artifact, or manually entered.

requirementTraceRows.title: Implementation Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to Tasks, Issues, Epics, Sprints, design records, source references, and commits where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to test cases, test results, manual verification records, CI runs, and evidence artifacts.

requirementTraceRows.title: Validation Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to human validation decisions and stakeholder approval evidence.

requirementTraceRows.title: Bidirectional Traceability
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support queries in both directions:

- From a requirement to implementing work, tests, evidence, and code references.
- From work, tests, evidence, and code references back to requirements.

requirementTraceRows.title: Traceability Gap Detection
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AirframeCore shall detect missing or incomplete traceability for in-scope requirements.

Example gaps:

- Requirement has no implementing work.
- Requirement has no verification method.
- Requirement has no passing verification evidence.
- Requirement has verification evidence but no validation decision where validation is required.
- Source reference claims a requirement that does not exist.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Scope
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support defining which requirements are in scope for a release candidate.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Gate Summary
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AgileCockpit shall show release candidate close criteria, including:

- In-scope requirements count.
- Implemented requirements count.
- Verified requirements count.
- Validated requirements count.
- Deferred or waived requirements count.
- Open deviations.
- Blocking traceability gaps.
- Blocking Issues.
- Missing test evidence.
- Missing human approvals.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deviation And Waiver Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support deviation and waiver records linked to affected requirements, rationale, authority, release scope, and expiration or review conditions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Test Result Summaries
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support storing summarized test result records that link to requirements.

Raw test logs may be external artifacts or CI artifacts and do not need to be committed to the repository.

requirementTraceRows.title: CI Integration Link
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support optional CI links for test results, coverage results, build results, and release candidate evidence.

requirementTraceRows.title: Code Reference Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support optional code-level trace references to requirements.

Supported references may include:

- Source comments.
- Test names.
- Test metadata.
- Work item records.
- Commit metadata.
- Generated source scans.

Airframe shall not require every requirement to be referenced directly in code comments unless project policy requires it.

requirementTraceRows.title: Compliance Document Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating traceability and compliance documents from canonical records and templates.

Initial document targets:

- Compliance Verification Matrix.
- Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Bidirectional Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Deviation or waiver report.
- Test plan.
- Verification report.
- Release candidate closeout report.

## 4. Import Export Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: CSV Import
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support importing requirements from CSV.

requirementTraceRows.title: CSV Export
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support exporting requirements and traceability summaries to CSV.

requirementTraceRows.title: JSON Import Export
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support importing and exporting canonical requirement records as JSON.

requirementTraceRows.title: Diffable Workflow
requirementTraceRows.statement: Requirement import/export files shall support review through Git diffs where practical.

requirementTraceRows.title: External Tool Stubs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall reserve import/export adapter boundaries for external requirements tools such as DOORS.

Native DOORS integration is out of scope for Version 1.0.

## 5. Release Gate Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Configurable Gate Policy
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall support configurable release gate policy.

requirementTraceRows.title: Default Gate Policy
requirementTraceRows.statement:
The default release candidate gate shall require:

- No blocking Issues.
- All in-scope requirements are implemented, deferred, waived, or explicitly out of scope.
- All in-scope non-deferred requirements have required verification evidence.
- All requirements requiring validation have validation approval.
- All deviations and waivers have approving authority.
- No blocking traceability diagnostics remain.

requirementTraceRows.title: Gate Explanation
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall explain why a release candidate can or cannot close.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Final release candidate closeout and validation approval shall require human authority.

## 6. Version 1.0 Boundary

Version 1.0 should provide a lightweight traceability foundation:

- Requirement records.
- CSV/JSON import/export.
- Requirement-to-work trace links.
- Requirement-to-test trace links.
- Test evidence summaries.
- Release gate summary.
- Generated traceability reports from simple templates.

Version 1.0 should avoid:

- Full DOORS replacement behavior.
- Deep external requirements-tool synchronization.
- Mandatory source-code annotation for all requirements.
- Heavy template authoring workflows.

dashboardDetailTextByID.EP-020:
# EP-020: Canonical Airframe Workflow State

**Status:** Closed
**Owner:** Human / Airframe Planning
**Start Date:** 2026-06-17
**Target Close Date:** 2026-06-23
**Close Date:** 2026-06-23

**Goal:**
Move Airframe workflow state from Markdown-authored artifacts to AirframeCore-owned canonical structured records, with validation diagnostics, migration support, generated documentation projections, and repo-coupled history.

**Rationale:**
EP-018 exposed that Markdown artifacts currently act as both human-readable documentation and mutable canonical state. That made Airframe vulnerable to inconsistent states where an Epic, Sprint, Task, Issue, index, workspace configuration, and GitHub label disagreed. Airframe now owns a canonical repo-local state model in AirframeCore so workflow state evolves with the source code and remains valid across branches, forks, checkouts, reverts, and release tags.

**Out of Scope:**
- Native DOORS or enterprise requirements-tool integration.
- Full release candidate closeout gating.
- Compliance document generation beyond schema stubs and projection groundwork.
- Removing existing Markdown artifacts before migration and projection behavior is verified.
- Making GitHub Issues the canonical source of Airframe workflow state.

**Notes:**
- Scope Completed: - Canonical AirframeCore record models were defined for Workspace, Project, Epic, Sprint, Task, Issue, acceptance criteria, evidence summaries, audit events, backend mappings, workflow definitions, and workflow transitions. - The repo-local structured store was implemented as one JSON file per canonical record kind. - Epic, Sprint, Task, and Issue workflow policies were encoded in AirframeCore instead of relying on guideline Markdown as authority. - Validation diagnostics were added for active/backlog/closed inconsistencies, relationship drift, invalid configured active work, and unsupported human-only mutations. - Import support from the current Markdown artifacts into canonical records was added. - Deterministic Markdown projection support for human-readable documentation was added. - AICockpit now queries canonical records for discovery, summaries, and task packets. - AgileCockpit now reads canonical records for dashboard and planning views. - Human-only authority boundaries remain enforced for verification, Sprint closure, Epic closure, destructive repair, and policy mutation.
- Acceptance Criteria: 1. [x] AirframeCore defines canonical Codable records for core work products, workflow policy, evidence summaries, and audit events. 2. [x] AirframeCore can load and validate a repo-local canonical workflow store. 3. [x] AirframeCore diagnostics detect invalid active/backlog/closed states and relationship drift. 4. [x] Existing Markdown work artifacts can be imported into canonical records with stable IDs preserved. 5. [x] Markdown documentation can be generated deterministically from canonical records. 6. [x] AICockpit reads project summaries and task packets from canonical records without reparsing Markdown as the primary state source. 7. [x] AgileCockpit dashboard and planning views can render from canonical records. 8. [x] Human-only transitions remain blocked outside human-authorized AgileCockpit workflows. 9. [x] Tests cover canonical load, validation, import, projection, and authority-preserving mutation behavior.

dashboardDetailTextByID.I-0020:
## I-0020: Canonical moves can leave stale reverse links on closed work

**Status:** Resolved - Not Verified
**GitHub Issue:** None
**Platform:** macOS
**Component:** AirframeCore / Canonical State / AgileCockpit / AICockpit
**Severity:** High
**Epic:** EP-022
**Sprint:** SP-034
**Date Identified:** 2026-06-26
**Fix Date:** 2026-06-26
**Verification Date:** TBD

**Description:**
After I-0015 through I-0019 were moved from EP-018/SP-024 to EP-022/SP-034, Data Health still reported the Issues as owned by closed EP-018. The Issue records and visible documentation showed EP-022/SP-034, but stale reverse links remained in canonical owner records and were not visible in the detail panel.

**Expected Behavior:**
Moving Tasks or Issues between Epics or Sprints should update child forward links and all owner reverse links through a single canonical operation. AgileCockpit should not hide canonical relationship arrays that Data Health uses for diagnostics.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Current stale canonical links are repaired so EP-018 and SP-024 no longer own I-0015 through I-0019.
2. AirframeCore exposes canonical move operations for Tasks and Issues that update old owner links, child forward links, and new owner links together.
3. `updateWorkRecord` and reconciliation helpers cannot leave Tasks or Issues linked from both old and new Epics or Sprints.
4. Regression coverage proves moving a Task or Issue off closed work clears stale reverse links.
5. AgileCockpit detail views expose canonical relationship state or clearly label non-canonical detail text.

**Resolution:**
Repaired EP-018 and SP-024 canonical reverse links, added canonical `moveTask` and `moveIssue` repository operations, made Task/Issue reconciliation remove stale owner links, reconciled Issue `updateWorkRecord` behavior, and appended canonical relationship data to AgileCockpit status detail text.

**Evidence:**
- `swift test --package-path AirframeCore` passed on 2026-06-26.
- `xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests` passed on 2026-06-26.
- `swift run --package-path AICockpit aicockpit state diagnostics --config .airframe/airframe-workspace.json --backend canonical --output json` passed with no diagnostics on 2026-06-26.

## T-0160: Define canonical test records and requirement trace model

**Status:** Implemented - Not Verified
**GitHub Issue:** #170
**Component:** AirframeCore / Canonical Test Model
**Priority:** High
**Epic:** EP-024
**Sprint Assigned:** SP-037

**Rationale:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Canonical state includes test case, test suite, and test run records.
2. Test records can link directly to acceptance criteria.

Added canonical test, test suite, and test run records with test kind/status enums; canonical JSON persistence under `state/tests`, `state/test-suites`, and `state/test-runs`; repository load-state support; requirement trace summaries that include test IDs; and canonical diagnostics for tests, suites, and runs that reference missing requirements, acceptance criteria, tests, suites, or work records. # EP-019: Airframe Offline-Only Operation

**Status:** Closed
**Owner:** Human / Airframe Planning
**Start Date:** TBD
**Target Close Date:** TBD
**Close Date:** 2026-07-06

**Goal:**
Make Airframe fully functional without GitHub or any backend server so the workspace, CLI, and app can operate entirely offline against local files and local state.

**Rationale:**
The current product still has live GitHub and controlled-remote paths. Those paths are useful, but they are not acceptable as a requirement for basic operation. Airframe must be able to load, inspect, mutate, verify, and archive work completely offline using local data only.

**Scope:**
- Audit all runtime paths in AirframeCore, AICockpit, and AgileCockpit for hidden GitHub or network dependencies.
- Ensure the local filesystem backend is sufficient for day-to-day project operation.
- Make the CLI usable against a purely local workspace without requiring GitHub authentication or network access.
- Make AgileCockpit usable against a purely local workspace without requiring GitHub authentication or network access.
- Preserve existing GitHub-backed functionality as optional, not required.
- Add offline regression coverage for project load, dashboard display, task packets, verification, planning, and archive updates.

**Out of Scope:**
- Removing GitHub support entirely.
- Building a network server or sync service.
- Replacing the local filesystem backend with a new storage engine.
- Changing human-only closeout policy.

### Related Sprints

| Sprint | Status |
| ---- | ---- |
| SP-035 |  |

### Related Tasks

| Task | Status |
| ---- | ---- |
| T-0148 |  |
| T-0149 |  |
| T-0150 |  |
| T-0151 |  |
| T-0152 |  |
| T-0153 |  |

**Notes:**
- Acceptance Criteria: 1. Airframe can launch and operate with only the local filesystem backend configured. 2. AICockpit can read, create, update, and transition supported work items offline. 3. AgileCockpit can load the dashboard, review view, planning view, and verification flows offline. 4. Sprint and Epic workflows do not require GitHub access or any remote server for core local operation. 5. Offline regression tests pass without network access or GitHub credentials. 6. GitHub-backed paths remain optional and do not block local workflows when unavailable.
- Implementation Plan: 1. Inventory all code paths that assume GitHub availability or a remote backend. 2. Separate local-first behavior from optional live-GitHub behavior in AirframeCore and the two client apps. 3. Add explicit offline-mode tests for AICockpit and AgileCockpit against local fixture data. 4. Harden configuration and failure messaging so missing GitHub credentials do not break local usage. 5. Verify that all essential workflows continue to work entirely from the local workspace, including archive and status updates.
- Related Areas: - `AirframeCore` - `AICockpit` - `AgileCockpit` - `docs/Tasks/` - `docs/Issues/` - `docs/Sprints/` - `docs/Epics/`
- Notes: - This Epic is about survivable product operation, not just “offline-friendly” fallback behavior. - If a feature cannot operate without GitHub or a server, it should be explicitly marked optional rather than assumed.

dashboardDetailTextByID.I-0021:
## I-0021: Active Sprint exclusivity is not enforced across canonical state

**Status:** Resolved - Not Verified
**GitHub Issue:** #159
**Platform:** macOS
**Component:** AirframeCore / Canonical State / Canonical Diagnostics / AgileCockpit
**Severity:** High
**Epic:** EP-022
**Sprint:** SP-034
**Date Identified:** 2026-06-26
**Fix Date:** 2026-06-26
**Verification Date:** TBD

**Description:**
AgileCockpit can show SP-034 as the current active Sprint in dashboard-style views while the header and Sprint Work tab show Sprint None. The active Sprint record exists, but the canonical project `activeSprintID` pointer is missing or stale, so different views use different current Sprint sources.

**Expected Behavior:**
For Airframe's current single-user, single-development-path workflow, only one Sprint may be Active at a time. The sole Active Sprint is the current Sprint by default, and `project.activeSprintID` must agree with it. Data Health should report multiple Active Sprints and should report a mismatch when exactly one Sprint is Active but the project active Sprint pointer is missing or different.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Canonical diagnostics detect more than one Active Sprint.
2. Canonical diagnostics detect exactly one Active Sprint when `project.activeSprintID` is missing or points elsewhere.
3. AgileCockpit header and Sprint Work tab use a consistent current Sprint source.
4. Regression coverage proves SP-034 active with nil project pointer is diagnosed or normalized.
5. Repair behavior must not silently choose between multiple Active Sprints.

**Resolution:**
Added Active Sprint exclusivity diagnostics, an `activeSprintPointerMismatch` diagnostic with a safe `setActiveSprintID` repair for the sole-active-Sprint case, preserved missing/invalid pointer diagnostics, updated AICockpit repair help, made AgileCockpit display and Sprint Work selection use a consistent current Sprint selector, and repaired `PRJ-AIRFRAME.activeSprintID` to `SP-034` through AICockpit.

**Evidence:**
- `swift test --package-path AirframeCore` passed on 2026-06-26.
- `swift test --package-path AICockpit` passed on 2026-06-26.
- `xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests` passed on 2026-06-26.
- `swift run --package-path AICockpit aicockpit state diagnostics --config .airframe/airframe-workspace.json --backend canonical --output json` passed with no diagnostics on 2026-06-26.

*Last Updated: 2026-07-06*

# EP-018: AgileCockpit Sprint and Epic Status Controls

**Status:** Closed
**Owner:** Human / Airframe Planning
**Start Date:** 2026-06-15
**Target Close Date:** TBD
**Close Date:** 2026-06-25

**Goal:**
Add human-facing AgileCockpit controls for Sprint and Epic status mutation, including Epic acceptance-criteria verification, Sprint close gating, and Epic close gating with archive updates.

**Rationale:**
The previous EP-017 Sprint series established the workflow dashboard, mutation authority, and Task/Issue verification flows. The remaining gap is that AgileCockpit still cannot help a human verify Epic acceptance criteria or close and archive a Sprint or Epic after the assigned work is complete.

**Scope:**
- Add an Epic Acceptance Criteria tab to the Sprint & Epic panel.
- Show each Epic acceptance criterion and allow it to be marked verified by a human reviewer.
- Gate Sprint close on all assigned Tasks and Issues being verified.
- Gate Epic complete and close on all acceptance criteria being verified.
- Archive closed Sprint and Epic records into the documented `Closed/` layout and update index files.
- Preserve existing human-only authority boundaries and keep agent-facing tools out of the close path.

**Out of Scope:**
- Granting AICockpit Sprint or Epic close authority.
- Automatic close without explicit human action.
- Creating GitHub issues for Epics or Sprints where no remote artifact store exists.
- Reworking the already closed EP-017 history.

dashboardDetailTextByID.I-0009:
## I-0009: Epic close leaves stale active pointers and sprint closeout state

**Status:** Resolved - Not Verified
**GitHub Issue:** #147
**Platform:** macOS
**Component:** AgileCockpit / AirframeCore / Canonical State
**Severity:** High
**Epic:** None
**Sprint:** None
**Date Identified:** 2026-06-25
**Fix Date:** 2026-06-25
**Verification Date:** TBD

**Description:**
Closing EP-021 in AgileCockpit transitioned the Epic to Closed but left the project active Epic pointer on EP-021. The project active Sprint pointer also remained stale on SP-032 after SP-032 and SP-033 were closed, which caused Data Health diagnostics to report closed work as active and exposed that active pointer cleanup was incomplete.

**Expected Behavior:**
When AgileCockpit closes an Epic, canonical project state should clear the active Epic pointer. Active Epic UI, release gate scope, and traceability scope should read the canonical project snapshot rather than stale configuration. Sprint closeout data should not leave a closed Sprint configured as active, and follow-up work should define whether closing a Sprint should advance, clear, or require explicit selection of the next current Sprint.

**Resolution:**
Added canonical active Epic clearing support, wired AgileCockpit Epic close to clear the canonical active Epic pointer, switched active Epic UI/scope reads to canonical project state, repaired EP-021/SP-033 canonical and Markdown closeout state, and restored the missing SP-029 canonical Sprint record.

**Files Affected:**
- `AirframeCore/Sources/AirframeCore/CanonicalStoreBackend.swift`
- `AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit/ContentView.swift`
- `AgileCockpit/AgileCockpitTests/AgileCockpitTests.swift`
- `.airframe/airframe-workspace.json`
- `.airframe/state/projects/PRJ-AIRFRAME.json`
- `.airframe/state/sprints/SP-029.json`
- `.airframe/state/sprints/SP-033.json`
- `docs/Epics/`
- `docs/Sprints/`
- `docs/Issues/`

**Follow-up:**
- Investigate and define current Sprint advancement behavior after closing a Sprint when another Sprint is already closed, active, or absent.
- Decide whether AgileCockpit should update `.airframe/airframe-workspace.json` active pointers or treat canonical project state as the only mutable active pointer source.

# EP-021: Requirements Traceability and Release Evidence

**Status:** Closed
**Owner:** Human / Airframe Planning
**Start Date:** 2026-06-23
**Target Close Date:** TBD
**Close Date:** 2026-06-24

**Goal:**
Add lightweight repo-coupled requirements traceability, test evidence summaries, release candidate gate visibility, external import/export stubs, and generated compliance documentation support without turning Airframe into a replacement for DOORS.

**Rationale:**
Airframe work products must connect implementation, tests, evidence, requirements, and release decisions. CI can provide test artifacts and build evidence, but AirframeCore must understand whether in-scope requirements have been implemented, verified, validated, deferred, waived, or blocked. Requirements are fluid during development, so the model must support change and import/export while preserving repo-local development history.

**Scope:**
- Define canonical requirement, requirement revision, trace link, test case, test result summary, deviation, waiver, release scope, and release gate records.
- Support requirement lifecycle states including Proposed, Draft, Active, Implemented, Verified, Validated, Deferred, Waived, Superseded, and Removed.
- Support traceability from requirements to Tasks, Issues, Epics, Sprints, tests, evidence, design records, source references, deviations, waivers, and release scopes.
- Support summarized test evidence linked to requirements without committing every raw local test run.
- Support optional links to CI runs, CI artifacts, build results, coverage results, and release candidate evidence.
- Add CSV and JSON import/export for requirements and traceability data, with dry-run import previews.
- Reserve adapter boundaries for future external requirements tools such as DOORS while keeping native DOORS integration out of Version 1.0.
- Add AgileCockpit views for release candidate close criteria, traceability gaps, deviations, waivers, missing test evidence, and missing human approvals.
- Add generated documentation support for Compliance Verification Matrix, Requirements Traceability Matrix, Bidirectional Requirements Traceability Matrix, deviation or waiver report, test plan, verification report, and release candidate closeout package when templates are available.

**Out of Scope:**
- Native DOORS integration.
- Full enterprise requirements management.
- Mandatory code-comment traceability for every requirement.
- Storing every raw local test run in the repository.
- Complex template authoring workflows.
- Final release closeout automation without human authority.

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirements.title: Project Dashboard
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display a consolidated dashboard for one or more configured projects.

requirements.title: Recently Completed Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display recently completed work items, including completed issues, tasks, merged pull requests, or backend-equivalent work records where available.

requirements.title: Active Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display currently active work items grouped by project, sprint, epic, status, or priority.

requirements.title: Upcoming Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display upcoming work items based on Airframe Core-provided priority, sprint, epic, backlog, or readiness information.

requirements.title: Blocked Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display blocked work items and associated blocked reasons where available.

requirements.title: Ready for Human Verification
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display work items that have been marked ready for human verification by an authorized actor.

requirements.title: Verification Review
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to review verification evidence associated with a work item.

requirements.title: Accept Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to accept completed work only after Airframe Core determines the operation is allowed by actor authority and workflow state.

requirements.title: Reject Work
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to reject work and return it to an appropriate workflow state with a required reason or comment.

requirements.title: Sprint Control
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close sprints, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirements.title: Epic Control
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close epics, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirements.title: Issue / Task Review
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display issues and tasks using canonical Airframe Core entity data independent of backend-specific storage.

requirements.title: Metrics Display
requirements.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall display Airframe Core-provided metrics including, at minimum:

- Sprint progress.
- Burndown.
- Velocity.
- Blocked work count.
- Recently completed work count.
- Work ready for verification.
- Aging of verification items.

requirements.title: Audit Visibility
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall provide access to audit events associated with project-management actions, including allowed and denied operations.

requirements.title: Multi-Project View
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support viewing multiple projects in a consolidated dashboard.

requirements.title: Project-Specific View
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support drilling into a single project for detailed review.

requirements.title: Backend-Agnostic Operation Display
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall present operations and entities using Airframe Core domain terms rather than backend-specific terminology where practical.

requirements.title: Denied Operation Reporting
requirements.statement:
When Airframe Core denies an operation, Agile Cockpit shall display the denial reason in human-readable form.

## 4. Security and Authority Requirements

requirements.title: Airframe Core API
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall use Airframe Core APIs for all project-management reads and writes.

requirements.title: Configuration Interface
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall load project and workspace configuration through Airframe Core-defined configuration interfaces.

requirements.title: Export Interface
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit should support exporting dashboard summaries or reports in Markdown, HTML, JSON, or other formats defined by project needs.

requirements.title: Accessibility Interface
requirements.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall provide accessible navigation, readable status indicators, keyboard access where applicable, and concise views suitable for low-click interaction.

## 7. Non-Functional Requirements

requirements.title: Usability
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall prioritize one- or two-click access to current status, recently completed work, active work, upcoming work, blocked work, and verification queues.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall be designed with accessibility as a primary concern.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall load dashboard summaries for configured projects without requiring full backend ingestion during routine use, where cached or summarized data is available.

requirements.title: Reliability
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall clearly report stale data, backend failures, authorization failures, and synchronization errors.

requirements.title: Backend Independence
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall not hard-code assumptions specific to GitHub or any other backend provider.

requirements.title: Maintainability
requirements.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall keep UI logic separate from Airframe Core workflow and authority logic.

---

## 8. Verification Requirements

requirements.title: Certified Actor Identity
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall rely on Airframe Core to certify actor identity and actor type before any write operation is requested.

requirements.title: No Self-Declared Authority
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall not allow a user or client process to self-declare an actor type for the purpose of obtaining authority.

requirements.title: Human-Only Operations
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall expose human-only operations only to authenticated and authorized human actor types as determined by Airframe Core.

requirements.title: Project Context Binding
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall include project context in all operation requests. Airframe Core shall determine whether the actor may operate on the target project.

requirements.title: Sensitive Operation Confirmation
requirements.statement: Agile Cockpit shall require explicit human confirmation before requesting sensitive operations such as closing a sprint, closing an epic, bulk status changes, or configuration changes.

requirements.title: Audit Event Generation
requirements.statement:
Agile Cockpit write operations shall result in Airframe Core-generated audit events.

---

requirements.title: Dashboard Verification
requirements.statement: Tests shall verify that Agile Cockpit displays project summaries, active work, upcoming work, blocked work, and recently completed work from Airframe Core-provided data.

requirements.title: Authority Verification
requirements.statement: Tests shall verify that human-only operations are not presented or are disabled for unauthorized actor types.

requirements.title: Workflow Verification
requirements.statement: Tests shall verify that Agile Cockpit properly handles allowed and denied Airframe Core workflow operations.

requirements.title: Metrics Verification
requirements.statement: Tests shall verify correct display of Airframe Core-provided burndown, velocity, and sprint progress metrics.

requirements.title: Accessibility Verification
requirements.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall undergo accessibility checks appropriate to the selected UI platform.

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirements.title: Canonical Project Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define canonical representations for projects, repositories, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, verification gates, evidence, actors, credentials, authority classes, workflow states, metrics, backend references, and audit events.

requirements.title: Actor Identity Certification
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall certify actor identity from trusted credential context, session information, or configured identity providers.

requirements.title: Actor Type Certification
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall derive actor type or authority class from certified identity and policy. Airframe Core shall not accept actor type as a trusted caller-provided assertion.

requirements.title: Project Context Binding
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall bind each operation to an execution project and target project and shall enforce project-scope rules.

requirements.title: Project Scope Mismatch Denial
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall deny mutation operations when execution project and target project do not match and no explicit cross-project delegation exists.

requirements.title: Authority Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define and enforce operation permissions by actor type, project context, target entity, credential scope, and workflow state.

requirements.title: Workflow State Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define workflow states for project entities and shall validate all requested state transitions.

requirements.title: Human-Only Gates
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall enforce human-only gates for accepting work, closing work, opening or closing sprints, opening or closing epics, approving architecture decisions, and changing workflow policies.

requirements.title: LLM-Allowed Operations
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall support LLM-allowed operations including proposing issues, proposing tasks, attaching evidence, and marking work ready for human verification.

requirements.title: Entity Creation
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall support creation of canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirements.title: Entity Update
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall support updates to canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirements.title: Entity Query
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall support queries for projects, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, evidence, verification gates, metrics, and audit events.

requirements.title: Sprint Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall model sprints, including status, date range, contained work, progress, completion state, and closure criteria.

requirements.title: Epic Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall model epics, including contained work, progress, status, and closure criteria.

requirements.title: Verification Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall model verification gates, evidence records, acceptance criteria, and human verification outcomes.

requirements.title: Task Packet Generation
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall generate compact task packets for AI Cockpit containing only relevant task context, constraints, acceptance criteria, verification commands, protected paths, and required reporting information.

requirements.title: Metrics Computation
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall compute project metrics including sprint progress, burndown, velocity, blocked work, recently completed work, upcoming work, active work, and verification aging.

requirements.title: Audit Event Generation
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall generate audit events for allowed and denied write operations.

requirements.title: Backend Adapter Interface
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define backend adapter interfaces for reading and writing canonical entities to external backends.

requirements.title: Backend Capability Model
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall support a capability model describing what each backend adapter can and cannot represent natively.

requirements.title: Backend Mapping
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall map canonical entities and operations to backend-specific representations through adapters.

requirements.title: Local Cache
requirements.statement: Airframe Core may maintain a local cache for performance, metrics, offline inspection, or dashboard generation. The cache shall not silently override authoritative backend state.

requirements.title: Configuration Model
requirements.statement:
Airframe Core shall define configuration for projects, backend adapters, actor policies, workflow rules, protected paths, verification commands, and cross-project delegations.

## 4. Security Requirements

requirements.title: Public API
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall expose a public API for client CSCIs to perform domain operations.

requirements.title: Read APIs
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall provide read APIs for dashboard summaries, project status, entity queries, metrics, task packets, and audit events.

requirements.title: Write APIs
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall provide write APIs for entity creation, entity update, workflow transitions, evidence attachment, sprint operations, epic operations, and verification operations.

requirements.title: Authority APIs
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall expose APIs for evaluating whether an operation is allowed, denied, or requires additional confirmation.

requirements.title: Backend Adapter API
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define a backend adapter interface to be implemented by provider-specific adapters.

requirements.title: Configuration API
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall define loading, validation, and querying of project and workflow configuration.

requirements.title: Audit API
requirements.statement:
Airframe Core shall expose audit event recording and query interfaces.

## 7. Backend Requirements

requirements.title: Sprint Progress
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall compute sprint progress based on sprint contents and work item status.

requirements.title: Burndown
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall compute burndown data where estimates and sprint date ranges are available.

requirements.title: Velocity
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall compute velocity across completed sprints where historical estimates are available.

requirements.title: Blocked Work
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall identify blocked work and blocked reasons.

requirements.title: Recently Completed Work
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall identify recently completed work based on workflow transition history or backend state.

requirements.title: Upcoming Work
requirements.statement: Airframe Core shall identify upcoming work from priority, sprint, epic, and readiness data.

requirements.title: Verification Aging
requirements.statement:
Airframe Core shall compute age of items waiting for human verification.
